shuts the start platform off from moving_platform_1716 (x 256 to 320, speed 0.4, stride 110: it starts 110 down, top y 248, rises to the door platform's
height, top y 138, on about tick 236 and on to y 28), and door_lift_1721 (x 353 to 383) shuts the corridor to the door until button_1723, in the
chamber under the door platform, is pressed; rolling_stone_1720 stands 50 units right of it. Four portals, far first and near second, twice.

the moving platform; he lands on it on 130 (taking crystal_ent_1728 on the way) and rides it up. From it the chamber is open under the door
platform's left end: a portal in the air over the button at (386, 204) (tap 138, placed on 163; the stone's exit: the chamber is 64 high, the stone 60)
and one in the stone (tap 174 at (436, 204): the ray ends 10 units inside it, at (416.6, 199.4), placed on 209). The stone goes in on 209 and comes
out over the button, which is pressed, and door_lift_1721 opens on 210 (to y -28.4 by about 244). Right is held from 210: he stands against the
door platform's left face (x 311.8 on 221) while the moving platform lifts him and steps across on 244, takes crystal_ent_1729 and _1730, walks
under the raised door and reaches the door on tick 289 (4 shots, aim drift at most 0.16 px, never out of the view). Unlocks achievement 64, Alone in
the dark I (the level in the dark, with the golden score: medal 3, 4 portals, 4,624 ms), and all 3 crystals. No knight, and the stone is sent from 150 units
away. Margins, each measured by moving the file: the hold's start 150 to 225 wins on 289 (235 on 297, 245 on 306, 255 and later is not won); the taps
after the first move together 3 earlier to 12 later (from the third on, 16 later; 18 is not won) and the last alone 6 earlier to 12 later; the first
tap's point x 258 to 298 and y 50 to 95, the third tap's x 362 to 404 and y 184 to 216, the fourth's x 416 to 456 and y 184 to 224 all win. The first tap is
2 ticks over the 400 ms floor (26 ticks of 16 ms); the later ones follow the last shot's landing by 3 ticks or more and the tap before it by 26 or more.
